reason: Conversation 2 correctly answered the homeowner's actual question (the chimney hood is a separate appliance from the hob), explained why humming without rotation is a stalled motor, and when the warm smell was disclosed it gave the right safety boundary: stop using it, isolate at the spur, call Bosch service or an engineer. Conversation 1 asked a redundant question the customer had already answered, then mislabelled the appliance as 'your hob', never established it was separate or out of scope, and never elicited the warm-smell fact, so its only safety advice was generic and conditional. Conversation 2 is marked down for overreaching with DIY capacitor-swap and ladder-based checks before learning the customer won't climb, and for leaning toward 'most likely the capacitor', but it hedged these as possibilities and corrected course appropriately once the constraints were known.
